content.user_title: Hand Off Work to a Fresh Claude Agent
content.value_statement: Long conversations make it hard to continue complex work across sessions. This skill creates a focused handoff summary and starts a background Claude agent with useful context.
actual_capabilities: Summarizes the current conversation for continuation by another agent.
Starts a background Claude agent with a descriptive session name.
Includes suggested skills that the next agent should consider.
References existing artifacts instead of repeating their full contents.
Redacts sensitive information before using the summary as a prompt.
limitations: It depends on the Claude CLI being available in the current environment.
It does not validate whether referenced paths or URLs still exist.
It cannot guarantee that all sensitive information is detected.
It focuses on handoff context, not completing the original task itself.

use_cases.title: Continue Long Debugging Sessions
use_cases.description: Create a concise handoff so a new agent can continue investigation without rereading the full conversation.

use_cases.title: Delegate Follow-Up Implementation
use_cases.description: Start a background agent with context, open tasks, referenced artifacts, and suggested skills for the next phase.

use_cases.title: Preserve Context Before Switching Tasks
use_cases.description: Capture current decisions and next steps before moving attention to another issue or support request.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Use claude-handoff to summarize this conversation and continue the same work in a fresh background agent.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: continue the current task without extra constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Focused Next Session
prompt_templates.prompt: Use claude-handoff for a next session focused on finishing tests and preparing a concise status update.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: define the next agent's primary focus.

prompt_templates.title: Artifact-Aware Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Use claude-handoff and reference existing plans, diffs, and issue links instead of repeating their full contents.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: preserve context while avoiding duplicate artifact content.

prompt_templates.title: Review-Oriented Continuation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use claude-handoff for a new agent that should review the implementation, cite existing artifacts, suggest skills, and protect sensitive data.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: prepare a continuation agent with review goals and safety boundaries.

output_examples.input: Start a handoff for fixing the login redirect bug.
output_examples.output: Creates a background Claude session named for the login redirect work and seeds it with summarized context, open questions, referenced artifacts, and suggested skills.

output_examples.input: Handoff this refactor to a new session focused on tests.
output_examples.output: Starts a new background session with the refactor status, relevant test goals, artifact references, and a note to avoid duplicating existing plans.

output_examples.input: Continue this investigation later without exposing secrets.
output_examples.output: Builds a redacted handoff summary and starts a background agent with the current findings, remaining checks, and sensitive data removed.

best_practices: Provide a clear focus area when starting the handoff.
Keep important plans, diffs, and decisions in referenced artifacts.
Review the handoff for sensitive information before sending it.
anti_patterns: Use the skill when the current agent can finish a small task directly.
Include secrets or personal data that the next agent does not need.
Ask the next agent to ignore existing plans or artifacts without reason.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It writes a handoff summary and starts a fresh background Claude agent with that summary as context.

faq.question: Does it save a handoff file?
faq.answer: No. The skill instructs the agent to start a background session instead of saving the summary.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report marks it as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it handle sensitive information?
faq.answer: It instructs the agent to redact API keys, passwords, and personal information before creating the handoff prompt.

faq.question: What should I provide as input?
faq.answer: Provide the focus for the next session, such as the bug, feature, review, or investigation to continue.

faq.question: Can the new agent access previous artifacts?
faq.answer: The handoff can reference paths or URLs, but access depends on the environment and available permissions.
